status: Written before pilot or response outcomes; locally frozen, not externally registered

equal_work.fixed_shape: Positive amplitude solves a*c+a*a/2=W for unit-RMS localized shape q and c=<u,q>. Amplitude is state dependent; report its complete distribution.
equal_work.equal_rms: Use three localized curls of the same periodized Gaussian vector-potential envelope. Project preferred direction onto the kernel of <u,q>; preserve RMS 0.02 and impose zero linear work. Direction changes by state; report all coefficients, angles and residuals. Deterministic least-aligned-axis fallback if the projection is nearly zero.
equal_work.limitations: Same shape, strength and work cannot all generally be matched across different states. Each equal-work method answers a different controlled question. Do not attribute their difference solely to memory.

forcing: In forced regimes, low modes 0<|k|infinity<=2 receive state-dependent negative damping with exact energy input 0.2 at every RK stage. Initial spinup is common to the two preparations, at n=96. Restart both comparison grids from the same saved spinup polynomial, restricting missing modes. Fixed forcing law continues through preparations and responses; its state-dependent response is part of the forced experiment.
turbulence_label: Report energy spectra, nonlinear transfers, dissipation, Kolmogorov resolution, Taylor Reynolds number and energy drift. These finite-time forced lower-viscosity regimes do not establish stationary fully developed turbulence or a universal inertial range. If numerical gates fail, withhold validated physical interpretations of that regime.
primary: At horizon 0.4, per fresh smooth flow in coincident layout with equal-work/equal-RMS probe, RMS across ten centers of difference between preparation histories' probe-minus-unprobed FTLE; retained minus mean of four scrambles. Bootstrap whole independent flow seeds.
secondary: Same contrasts in other methods/layouts/regimes; matched-translation minus scramble specificity; method and layout differences paired within flow; unadjusted exploratory intervals. Forced regimes have four independent flows and remain exploratory.
refinement: Every production flow/layout/regime on both declared grids; first two seeds of every regime/layout additionally at half step on finer grid. Pilot numerical outcomes may trigger a separately saved refinement amendment before production effects are examined; never relax thresholds.
independent_solver: Separately written CPU full-complex Fourier coefficients, padded conservative flux divergence, independent projection and spectral observation, SciPy adaptive DOP853. No reference evolution/evaluation code imported. Compare all branches at n=32, horizon 0.4, for first two smooth coincident seeds; full n=64 retained/scramble0 states with fixed-RMS and equal-work/equal-RMS probes at horizon 0.1 for first forced seed of each viscosity. Repeat at tighter tolerance. This is a second implementation by the same author, not external independent replication; forced comparisons cover a shorter horizon.
identity_controls: Two smooth seeds jointly translate initial flow, writer, probe and observation positions; responses must agree within 1e-10. Marker permutation, identical full-state reset, conjugacy, modal powers and energy increments verified. Spatial layouts are paired conditions, not independent samples.
scope: Actual incompressible Navier-Stokes; passive observation points, no molecules, leadership, learning, isotope substitution or extra memory term. All results are follow-ups to a known result and are not independent confirmation of the original selection.
